task: Bound the two harden-runner portal jobs with timeout-minutes so an egress-blocked checkout fails fast instead of hanging (#462); mitigation only, root cause stays open.

events.summary: Only portal-test.yml test and browser-e2e jobs. Egress policy, allowlist, harden-runner version and gate logic unchanged.

Runs 39959435709 (#454) and 39966255902 (#461): checkout failed 'Failed to connect to github.com port 443 after 2 ms' under egress_policy block with github.com:443 allowed, then the job hung ~25 min in post steps until force-cancel.

timeout-minutes: 15 on both harden-runner jobs (normal runtime 1-1.5 min, measured from recent runs). portal-gate/check-regression-results.mjs treats any non-success result, including cancelled, as failure, so a timeout fails closed.
